description: Headings edited by hand around their IDs (previous.md): white space before and after the GUID (two spaces, a tab, a no-break space) is trimmed as .NET's GUID parser trims it, so each still opens its lesson's section; an upper-case GUID is the same lesson. Each section differs from what the sink writes now, so the three current lessons are updated, and a lesson the file held that is gone is removed.
